description: [Free] Stops a running render and refunds its render credit and any AI visual still in flight; AI visuals already made stay (reused free). Use it when get_storyboard shows a plan you do not want. A finished render cannot be cancelled. The video is marked cancelled at once; the worker stops at its next step.
